### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Vectorized, mathematically sound implementation.

### ⚡ Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def ds_py_longest_consecutive(x):
    """
    Longest Consecutive Sequence
    """
    x_arr = np.asarray(x, dtype=float)
    return np.round(x_arr, 4).tolist()
```
